editorialNote: Literary excerpts keep the source wording. Printed line breaks, quotation marks, and terminal punctuation are lightly normalized for cards. Personal messages are original Maison de Gaby wording and are not attributed to the quoted authors.

cards.title: Always you
cards.quote: To me, fair friend, you never can be old
cards.author: William Shakespeare
cards.message: Another year of your warmth, your wonder, your irreplaceable light. Happy birthday, with all my love.

cards.title: Little wonders
cards.quote: To me every hour of the light and dark is a miracle
cards.author: Walt Whitman
cards.message: May this year bring you small wonders, brave wishes, and all the love you so easily give. Happy birthday.

cards.title: Still my favourite
cards.quote: All, everything that I understand, I understand only because I love.
cards.author: Leo Tolstoy
cards.message: Another year, and still you make the ordinary feel extraordinary. Happy anniversary, my love.

source.title: War and Peace
source.locator: Book XII, Chapter XVI; Louise and Aylmer Maude translation

cards.title: Always us
cards.quote:
Love is not love
Which alters when it alteration finds
cards.author: William Shakespeare
cards.message: For all we have been, all we are, and all we have yet to become. Still you. Still us.

cards.title: Ardently yours
cards.quote: You must allow me to tell you how ardently I admire and love you.
cards.author: Jane Austen
cards.message: Of all the ways life could have unfolded, finding you is still my favourite. Happy Valentine’s Day.

cards.title: The sweetest ordinary
cards.quote: Love gives naught but itself and takes naught but from itself.
cards.author: Kahlil Gibran
cards.message: With you, even an ordinary afternoon feels like something worth keeping. All my love, today and always.

cards.title: You rose
cards.quote:
We never know how high we are
Till we are called to rise
cards.author: Emily Dickinson
cards.message: For the quiet work no one saw, and this wonderful moment everyone can celebrate. I am so proud of you.

cards.title: Beautifully earned
cards.quote: Work is love made visible.
cards.author: Kahlil Gibran
cards.message: Today, all that care has a name: success. You earned every lovely part of this. Congratulations.

cards.title: Your own verse
cards.quote: That the powerful play goes on, and you may contribute a verse.
cards.author: Walt Whitman
cards.message: The world has room for your voice. Here’s to the extraordinary verse you will write. Congratulations, graduate.

cards.title: Beyond the last page
cards.quote: Our statures touch the skies.
cards.author: Emily Dickinson
cards.message: Every page, every effort, every late night brought you here. Now let curiosity lead you somewhere wonderful.

cards.title: A home in each other
cards.quote: You were born together, and together you shall be forevermore.
cards.author: Kahlil Gibran
cards.message: May your home be rich in laughter, gentle in difficult hours, and always a place to return to.

cards.title: A beautiful beginning
cards.quote:
Let me not to the marriage of true minds
Admit impediments.
cards.author: William Shakespeare
cards.message: Two lives, one beautiful beginning. Wishing you a love that grows more generous with the years.

cards.title: A little love returned
cards.quote: It is when you give of yourself that you truly give.
cards.author: Kahlil Gibran
cards.message: You have given so much of yourself. Today, let a little sweetness come back to you. Thank you, from my heart.

cards.title: The kindness that stays
cards.quote:
If I can stop one heart from breaking,
I shall not live in vain
cards.author: Emily Dickinson
cards.message: You made a difficult day softer and an ordinary moment kinder. Some kindnesses stay with us. Yours will.

cards.title: One of my people
cards.quote: Your friend is your needs answered.
cards.author: Kahlil Gibran
cards.message: Some people make life easier to carry and brighter to remember. I’m so glad you are one of mine.

cards.title: The comfort of you
cards.quote:
But if the while I think on thee, dear friend,
All losses are restor’d and sorrows end.
cards.author: William Shakespeare
cards.message: For the conversations, the laughter, and the simple comfort of being understood. So lucky to have you.

cards.title: A chapter of your own
cards.quote: Things do not change; we change.
cards.author: Henry David Thoreau
cards.message: This new chapter need not have every answer. May it bring you closer to the life you wish to make.

cards.title: Fresh light
cards.quote: Afoot and light-hearted I take to the open road
cards.author: Walt Whitman
cards.message: New doors. Fresh light. A little courage. May you find a place that feels beautifully your own.

cards.title: A little hope
cards.quote:
Hope is the thing with feathers
That perches in the soul
cards.author: Emily Dickinson
cards.message: Wishing you gentler days, unhurried rest, and small reasons to smile. You are loved, exactly as you are.

cards.title: Rest gently
cards.quote: For in the dew of little things the heart finds its morning and is refreshed.
cards.author: Kahlil Gibran
cards.message: A small comfort for a quieter day. Rest gently; you are loved, and there is no need to hurry.

cards.title: The heart of home
cards.quote: There is no charm equal to tenderness of heart
cards.author: Jane Austen
cards.message: For every ordinary day you filled with extraordinary care. You are the heart of so much that is good in my life. Happy Mother’s Day.

cards.title: My first kind of love
cards.quote: Love is life.
cards.author: Leo Tolstoy
cards.message: Before I knew the word for love, I knew you. Thank you for the warmth I still carry everywhere. Happy Mother’s Day.

source.title: War and Peace
source.locator: Book XII, Chapter XVI; Louise and Aylmer Maude translation

cards.title: The goodness you gave
cards.quote: Goodness is the only investment that never fails.
cards.author: Henry David Thoreau
cards.message: For the steady love, the quiet lessons, and the goodness you taught me to carry. Happy Father’s Day.

cards.title: Because you believed
cards.quote: You are the bows from which your children as living arrows are sent forth.
cards.author: Kahlil Gibran
cards.message: For helping me find my own way, and making sure I always knew the way home. With love, this Father’s Day.

cards.title: The joy of gathering
cards.quote: And in the sweetness of friendship let there be laughter, and sharing of pleasures.
cards.author: Kahlil Gibran
cards.message: Eid Mubarak. May our table be full, our hearts lighter, and our time together beautiful.

cards.title: Goodness at every table
cards.quote: And there is no greatness where simplicity, goodness, and truth are absent.
cards.author: Leo Tolstoy
cards.message: Eid Mubarak. May goodness fill our homes, love gather us close, and joy find room at every table.

source.title: War and Peace
source.locator: Book XIV, Chapter XVIII; Louise and Aylmer Maude translation
